entries.name: Button
entries.keyboard: Native button: Tab focuses, Enter and Space activate. With `render`, the rendered element must stay focusable and keep button semantics.
entries.use: Every clickable action: form submission, toolbar and composer actions, icon-only actions. `size="compact"` is the toolbar size family; `icon*` sizes need an accessible name.
entries.avoid: Restyling with arbitrary radius, fill or font classes, or calling `buttonVariants` from app code to dress a non-button. Use Badge for static status and a link for navigation that is not an action.

entries.name: Toggle
entries.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter and Space flip the pressed state, exposed as aria-pressed.
entries.use: A two-state control whose state is visible on the control itself, such as a formatting or view toggle.
entries.avoid: Settings that persist a preference (use Switch) or a choice among peers (use ToggleGroup).

entries.name: Toggle group
entries.keyboard: Base UI roving focus: Tab enters the group, arrow keys move between items, Enter and Space press the focused item.
entries.use: A small set of mutually related options shown inline, such as a view switch (board or list) or a segmented range picker.
entries.avoid: Long or dynamic option lists (use Select) and independent actions that merely sit together (use Group).

entries.name: Panel tab close button
entries.keyboard: A focusable button inside the tab; Enter and Space close the tab.
entries.use: The close affordance of a right-panel or surface tab.
entries.avoid: Dismissing dialogs, toasts or banners; they own their close controls.

entries.name: Refresh icon
entries.keyboard: Not focusable; the enclosing Button owns keyboard access and the accessible name.
entries.use: The glyph inside a refresh or retry Button; `refreshing` spins it while the request runs, honouring reduced motion.
entries.avoid: A standalone loading indicator (use Spinner) or a decorative animation.

entries.name: Input
entries.keyboard: Native text input editing and selection.
entries.use: Single-line text entry with an associated Label; `size="compact"` in toolbars and dense rows.
entries.avoid: Multi-line text (use Textarea), choices from a known list (use Select or Combobox) and search inside a popup (the Command and Combobox inputs own that).

entries.name: Textarea
entries.keyboard: Native multi-line editing; Enter inserts a newline.
entries.use: Multi-line form text such as descriptions and notes; it sizes to its content.
entries.avoid: The conversation or issue prompt: the composer's Lexical editor owns rich prompt input.

entries.name: Label
entries.keyboard: Clicking the label focuses or toggles its associated control.
entries.use: The visible name of every form control, associated through htmlFor or by wrapping the control.
entries.avoid: Section headings or decorative captions; a placeholder or tooltip is not a substitute label.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.keyboard: Tab focuses; Space toggles.
entries.use: Independent selections and multi-select of rows; indeterminate for a partially selected group.
entries.avoid: An immediately applied on/off preference (use Switch) or one choice among peers.

entries.name: Switch
entries.keyboard: Tab focuses; Space toggles.
entries.use: A boolean setting that takes effect immediately, typically as the trailing control of a SettingsRow.
entries.avoid: Selections submitted with a form (use Checkbox) and actions (use Button).

entries.name: Radio group
entries.keyboard: Base UI radio group: Tab enters the group, arrow keys move and select.
entries.use: One visible choice among a few peers in a form.
entries.avoid: Long lists (use Select), view switches (use ToggleGroup) and independent options (use Checkbox).

entries.name: Number field
entries.keyboard: Base UI number field: arrow keys step the value; increment and decrement buttons are focusable.
entries.use: Bounded numeric entry with steppers.
entries.avoid: Free-form identifiers that happen to be digits; use Input.

entries.name: Input group
entries.keyboard: The inner input keeps native editing; addons that are buttons are separately focusable.
entries.use: An input with attached prefix, suffix or action addons.
entries.avoid: Hand-building addon frames around Input in a feature folder.

entries.name: Draft input
entries.keyboard: Native editing; the value commits on blur or Enter.
entries.use: A text setting that should commit once editing finishes rather than on every keystroke.
entries.avoid: Form fields submitted together; they keep ordinary controlled Inputs.

entries.name: Color picker
entries.keyboard: plane and slider respond to arrow keys.
entries.use: Choosing an arbitrary colour.
entries.avoid: Picking from Detent's semantic palette; offer the named options instead.

entries.name: Calendar
entries.keyboard: day grid: arrow keys move between days, Enter selects.
entries.use: Picking a date inside a Popover.
entries.avoid: Relative time choices (use Select with named ranges).

entries.name: Select
entries.keyboard: Base UI select: Enter, Space or arrow keys open; arrow keys move; typeahead jumps; Enter selects; Escape closes and returns focus.
entries.use: One saved value from a short, known list. Use SelectButton to give a Menu or Combobox trigger the same field look.
entries.avoid: Searchable or long lists (use Combobox) and lists of actions (use Menu).

entries.name: Combobox
entries.keyboard: Type to filter; arrow keys move the highlight; Enter selects; Escape closes. Chips are removable with Backspace from an empty input.
entries.use: Choosing one or more values from a long or searchable list, such as projects, models or labels.
entries.avoid: Short fixed lists (use Select) and global navigation (use the command palette).

entries.name: Autocomplete
entries.keyboard: Type to filter suggestions; arrow keys move the highlight; Enter accepts; Escape closes. The typed text remains the value.
entries.use: Free text with suggestions, and the input layer the Command primitive builds on.
entries.avoid: Choosing from a closed set (use Combobox or Select).

entries.name: Command
entries.keyboard: Focus starts in the search input; arrow keys move between items; Enter runs the highlighted item; Escape closes the dialog and returns focus.
entries.use: The searchable command surface behind the command palette and similar quick-pick dialogs.
entries.avoid: A second palette implementation in a feature folder; extend the command palette's sources instead.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.keyboard: Focus moves into the dialog and is contained; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger.
entries.use: A focused task that interrupts the page: a short form, a confirmation with input, a detail that needs the whole attention.
entries.avoid: Destructive confirmations (use AlertDialog), docked panels (use Sheet) and contextual pickers (use Popover).

entries.name: Alert dialog
entries.keyboard: Focus is contained; Escape cancels; the backdrop does not dismiss; focus returns to the trigger.
entries.use: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action, with a clear destructive Button and a cancel path.
entries.avoid: Informational messages (use Alert or a toast) and forms (use Dialog).

entries.name: Sheet
entries.keyboard: Dialog semantics: focus is contained, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.
entries.use: A panel docked to a viewport edge, chiefly to present the sidebar and right panel on narrow viewports.
entries.avoid: Centered tasks (use Dialog); wide desktop layouts keep panels inline.

entries.name: Popover
entries.keyboard: The trigger opens it; focus moves into interactive content; Escape closes and returns focus.
entries.use: A small contextual interaction anchored to its trigger: a filter, a short form, pinned help.
entries.avoid: Lists of actions (use Menu), hover-only supplementary text (use Tooltip) and long tasks (use Dialog).

entries.name: Menu
entries.keyboard: Enter, Space or arrow keys open from the trigger; arrow keys move; typeahead jumps; Enter activates; ArrowRight opens a submenu; Escape closes and returns focus.
entries.use: A list of actions or toggles behind a trigger: overflow menus, row actions, lane menus.
entries.avoid: Choosing a saved value (use Select) and searching (use Combobox or Command).

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.keyboard: Opens when its trigger receives keyboard focus; Escape closes. Content is not focusable.
entries.use: Brief supplementary text for a control that already has an accessible name, such as an icon button's label and shortcut.
entries.avoid: The only accessible name of a control, essential instructions, or interactive content (use Popover).

entries.name: Preview card
entries.keyboard: Opens on hover or focus of its link trigger; the link itself stays the keyboard path to the content.
entries.use: A rich preview of a linked entity, such as a pull request link preview.
entries.avoid: Content the user must act on (use Popover) and plain hints (use Tooltip).

entries.name: Alert
entries.keyboard: Not interactive itself; AlertAction holds focusable actions.
entries.use: A persistent inline message in the place the user must act: a warning above a form, an unavailable state with a corrective action.
entries.avoid: Transient confirmations (use a toast) and status labels (use Badge).

entries.name: Badge
entries.keyboard: Static by default; with `render` it can become a link or button and takes that element's keyboard behaviour.
entries.use: A short static status or count with semantic colour, paired with text so colour is not the only signal.
entries.avoid: Actions (use Button) and context reference chips in the composer (use the file tag chip).

entries.name: Toast
entries.keyboard: Toasts are announced politely; action and close buttons are focusable; the stacked thread toast expands with its toggle button.
entries.use: Transient feedback about an action's outcome, scoped to a thread where relevant; anchored copy toasts confirm a copy next to its button.
entries.avoid: Errors the user must fix in place (use Alert or field errors) and progress that needs a persistent surface.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.keyboard: Not focusable.
entries.use: Indeterminate progress inside a control or small region, keeping the surrounding layout and label stable.
entries.avoid: Loading a whole region whose shape is known (use Skeleton).

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.keyboard: Not focusable.
entries.use: A placeholder with the shape of content that is loading, using the shared stepped animation.
entries.avoid: Inventing another shimmer, and showing skeletons for content that failed to load (show the error state).

entries.name: Empty state
entries.keyboard: Not interactive itself; EmptyContent holds focusable actions.
entries.use: Explaining why a region has no content and offering the relevant next action.
entries.avoid: Errors and unavailable capabilities that are not simply absence (use Alert).

entries.name: Sidebar primitive
entries.keyboard: SidebarTrigger and menu buttons are native buttons or links; the rail is a resize handle. On narrow viewports the sidebar opens as a Sheet with dialog focus handling.
entries.use: The building blocks of Detent's app sidebar: provider, rail, groups and SidebarMenuButton rows with the shared hover, active and selected tokens.
entries.avoid: Using it for in-page navigation lists; settings use SettingsSidebarNav, which composes these blocks.

entries.name: Scroll area
entries.keyboard: The viewport is focusable and scrolls with arrow, Page and Home/End keys.
entries.use: Any bounded scrolling region inside panels, popups and lists, optionally with scroll fades.
entries.avoid: Wrapping the page body; the document scrolls natively.

entries.name: Separator
entries.keyboard: Not focusable.
entries.use: A quiet horizontal or vertical divider between rows, groups and toolbar sections.
entries.avoid: Wrapping sections in cards just to separate them.

entries.name: Group
entries.keyboard: Each grouped control keeps its own focus; the group adds none.
entries.use: Joining related buttons, inputs and text segments into one attached control, such as a split action.
entries.avoid: Exclusive choices (use ToggleGroup) and loose toolbars (use a flex row with gap-2).

entries.name: Collapsible
entries.keyboard: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded; Enter and Space toggle.
entries.use: Showing and hiding a secondary section in place, such as tool details or a lane.
entries.avoid: Hiding primary content or required form fields.

entries.name: Collapsible section header
entries.keyboard: A button header with aria-expanded; Enter and Space toggle.
entries.use: A ruled, toned section header that owns collapse geometry, when a feature needs one.
entries.avoid: Disclosure inside content (use Collapsible) and restyling existing sidebar sections with it.

entries.name: Middle truncate
entries.keyboard: Not interactive; the full string remains selectable and readable by assistive technology.
entries.use: Branch names, paths, worktree names and shas whose meaning is at both ends.
entries.avoid: Prose and titles, which truncate at the end.

entries.name: Table
entries.keyboard: Native table semantics; interactive cells hold their own focusable controls.
entries.use: Tabular data such as usage and billing rows: labels left-aligned, comparable numbers right-aligned with tabular numerals.
entries.avoid: Layout grids and lists of navigable entities (use rows or cards from the owning composition).

entries.name: Keyboard key
entries.keyboard: Not focusable.
entries.use: Showing a keyboard shortcut in tooltips, menus and the command palette.
entries.avoid: Inline code or values (use the markdown code style).

entries.name: Discovery list
entries.keyboard: Rows with actions expose them as buttons.
entries.use: A bordered list of icon, title and description rows for discovering integrations or options.
entries.avoid: Settings rows (use SettingsRow).

entries.name: Standalone page
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: Page and card geometry for an entry point outside the app shell.
entries.avoid: Pages inside the workspace shell (use WorkspacePageContainer).

entries.name: Wizard
entries.keyboard: Dialog semantics from DialogPopup; step navigation buttons are focusable.
entries.use: A multi-step flow in a dialog whose step logic stays with the caller.
entries.avoid: Single-step forms (use Dialog).

entries.name: QR code
entries.keyboard: Not focusable; pair it with the same value as text.
entries.use: Pairing a device by scanning.
entries.avoid: The only way to convey a link or token.

entries.name: App sidebar layout
entries.keyboard: Hosts the sidebar control; focus order runs sidebar first, then the main region.
entries.use: The shell around every workspace route: sidebar provider, resizable thread sidebar and the main inset.
entries.avoid: Nesting a second shell or sidebar inside a route.

entries.name: Thread sidebar
entries.keyboard: Thread, draft and search-result rows are links or buttons in document order; row menus open with Enter or Space; drag reordering has a menu alternative.
entries.use: The app's navigation list: project sections, thread rows (SidebarThreadRow), draft rows, search results and the snooze control, rendered with the Sidebar primitive.
entries.avoid: New row shapes or status colours; extend the existing row and ThreadStatusIndicators instead.

entries.name: Sidebar chrome
entries.keyboard: Header and footer items are buttons or links; the utility menu is a Menu.
entries.use: The sidebar's header (brand, primary actions) and footer (utility menu, update pill).
entries.avoid: Adding feature shortcuts to the chrome; destinations belong in the sidebar sections or command palette.

entries.name: Detent wordmark
entries.keyboard: Not focusable; a surrounding link carries the accessible name.
entries.use: The Detent brand mark in the sidebar chrome and entry screens.
entries.avoid: Redrawing or recolouring the mark per feature.

entries.name: Workspace page header
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own; holds the breadcrumb and header actions in reading order.
entries.use: The top bar of every workspace page at --workspace-topbar-height, with native titlebar and safe-area insets.
entries.avoid: Building a per-feature header or patching its gutter independently of the page container.

entries.name: Workspace page container
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: The content column of a non-chat page (settings, usage, work pages) at one of three widths.
entries.avoid: Ad-hoc max-width wrappers.

entries.name: Workspace breadcrumb
entries.keyboard: Items are links in reading order.
entries.use: The location trail inside WorkspacePageHeader.
entries.avoid: Using it as tabs or a menu.

entries.name: Command palette
entries.keyboard: Opened by the command-palette keybinding; arrow keys move; Enter runs; Escape closes and returns focus.
entries.use: Global search and command dispatch across conversations, projects and destinations.
entries.avoid: Page-specific pickers; they use Combobox or Menu.

entries.name: Command palette content
entries.keyboard: As Command: arrow keys, Enter, Escape.
entries.use: The palette's input, grouped result rows and footer, shared by the palette and its sub-pickers.
entries.avoid: Rendering palette rows outside the palette.

entries.name: Project favicon
entries.keyboard: Not focusable.
entries.use: A project's identity mark in sidebar sections, pickers and headers.
entries.avoid: Initials or newly drawn logos.

entries.name: Thread status indicators
entries.keyboard: Indicators are decorative or carry tooltips on focusable rows; they add no focus stops.
entries.use: The one mapping from thread and pull-request state to icon, colour and label, used by sidebar rows and headers.
entries.avoid: A second status mapping in a feature.

entries.name: Git actions control
entries.keyboard: A Group of a Button and a Menu trigger; menu keyboard behaviour as Menu.
entries.use: The chat header's source-control actions.
entries.avoid: Separate commit or push buttons elsewhere in the header.

entries.name: Chat header
entries.keyboard: The title is renamable inline (Enter commits, Escape cancels); header actions are buttons and menus.
entries.use: The conversation's header content inside WorkspacePageHeader: title, git actions, open-in and panel controls.
entries.avoid: Adding feature diagnostics to the header.

entries.name: Conversation timeline
entries.keyboard: As MessagesTimeline.
entries.use: Detent's adapter that turns hub messages, questions and proposals into MessagesTimeline entries and hosts the expanded image dialog.
entries.avoid: Rendering messages directly; add entry kinds through the adapter.

entries.name: Messages timeline
entries.keyboard: A virtualized list in reading order; message actions (copy, expand) are buttons revealed on hover and focus.
entries.use: The transcript: user messages on the message surface, assistant content in the reading lane, tool activity, plans and changed files.
entries.avoid: A second transcript renderer, for example for issue discussions.

entries.name: Chat markdown
entries.keyboard: Links, code-block copy buttons and file actions are focusable in reading order.
entries.use: Every markdown body: assistant messages, plans, issue descriptions and comments (Detent's Markdown wrapper delegates to it).
entries.avoid: Another markdown renderer or hand-styled prose.

entries.name: Composer
entries.keyboard: The prompt editor takes focus; Enter sends and Shift+Enter inserts a newline; slash and mention menus open from typed triggers with arrow-key navigation.
entries.use: The one prompt surface for conversations and issues: editor, attachments, context strip, pending questions, banners and primary actions, assembled from the composer parts (surface, controls, banners, primary actions).
entries.avoid: Building a second composer or provider picker; the issue page reuses this composition.

entries.name: Composer surface
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: The composer's rounded glass frame and attached-banner geometry.
entries.avoid: Applying the control radius or a card to the composer.

entries.name: Composer control
entries.keyboard: Buttons and select triggers; aria-pressed marks toggles such as plan mode.
entries.use: The composer toolbar's preference controls (model, effort, mode).
entries.avoid: Using it outside the composer; elsewhere use Button size="compact".

entries.name: Composer primary actions
entries.keyboard: Send and stop are buttons; Enter in the editor triggers send.
entries.use: Send, stop and related primary actions at the composer's trailing edge.
entries.avoid: A second send button elsewhere.

entries.name: Composer banner
entries.keyboard: Banner actions are buttons in reading order.
entries.use: A notice attached to the top of the composer (provider status, thread error, usage limits).
entries.avoid: Page-level alerts or toasts placed over the composer.

entries.name: Composer banner stack
entries.keyboard: The stack expands with a button; each banner keeps its actions.
entries.use: Stacking several composer banners so one leads and the rest peek behind it.
entries.avoid: Rendering multiple ComposerBanners side by side.

entries.name: Pending user input panel
entries.keyboard: Answer options are buttons; numeric shortcuts select options where shown.
entries.use: A question or approval the agent is waiting on, answered in place above the composer.
entries.avoid: Dialogs for agent questions.

entries.name: File tag chip
entries.keyboard: Inline in the editor; removed with Backspace like text.
entries.use: A file or context reference inside the prompt and in sent messages.
entries.avoid: Status (use Badge) or actions (use Button).

entries.name: Proposed plan card
entries.keyboard: Expand and copy controls are buttons.
entries.use: A plan the agent proposes, rendered as a card in the timeline.
entries.avoid: Using the card for ordinary assistant messages.

entries.name: Right panel workspace
entries.keyboard: Delegates to RightPanelTabs and the active surface.
entries.use: Detent's owner of the right panel: claims the workspace and routes each tab to its surface.
entries.avoid: Opening surfaces outside the right panel.

entries.name: Right panel tabs
entries.keyboard: Tabs are focusable; surface shortcuts switch tabs; each tab's close button is separately focusable.
entries.use: The tab strip that switches right-panel surfaces (Diff, Files, Terminal, Output, Preview).
entries.avoid: Page-level tabs (use ToggleGroup).

entries.name: Right panel sheet
entries.keyboard: Sheet semantics: focus is contained, Escape closes.
entries.use: Presenting the right panel as a Sheet on narrow viewports.
entries.avoid: Using it for content other than the right panel.

entries.name: Right panel resize handle
entries.keyboard: A pointer resize affordance between the main region and the panel.
entries.use: Resizing the inline right panel.
entries.avoid: Custom drag handles per surface.

entries.name: Diff panel shell
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own; header controls are buttons.
entries.use: The header and body frame of the Diff surface, including its loading state.
entries.avoid: Reimplementing the frame for other surfaces; Preview uses PreviewPanelShell.

entries.name: Preview panel shell
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: The resizable inline frame that hosts right-panel surfaces beside the conversation.
entries.avoid: Placing surfaces in ad-hoc columns.

entries.name: Diff surface
entries.keyboard: File navigation and annotations are buttons; the diff renderer is scrollable.
entries.use: The right panel's diff of an attempt's changes, rendered by Pierre diffs inside DiffPanelShell.
entries.avoid: Restyling diff syntax tokens; adapt semantic colours at the renderer boundary.

entries.name: Files surface
entries.keyboard: Breadcrumb menus and the file tree are keyboard navigable; the code view scrolls.
entries.use: The read-only file viewer: breadcrumbs and toggles in a sub-header, the code pane and the explorer aside.
entries.avoid: Adding editing or write actions; this slice is read-only.

entries.name: File breadcrumbs
entries.keyboard: Each segment opens a Menu of its directory; arrow keys and Enter navigate.
entries.use: The path of the open file in the Files surface, with sibling navigation.
entries.avoid: Page breadcrumbs (use WorkspaceBreadcrumb).

entries.name: File browser panel
entries.keyboard: Pierre tree navigation: arrow keys move and expand, Enter opens.
entries.use: The Files surface's explorer tree.
entries.avoid: Another tree implementation.

entries.name: Terminal surface
entries.keyboard: The xterm view takes keyboard input while focused; Tab is captured by the terminal.
entries.use: A runner terminal stream in the right panel.
entries.avoid: Prose typography or generic cards around terminal output.

entries.name: Output surface
entries.keyboard: Scrollable output with focusable run controls.
entries.use: The recorded output of project actions and scripts.
entries.avoid: Live interactive sessions (use the Terminal surface).

entries.name: Pull request surface
entries.keyboard: Links and actions in reading order.
entries.use: A linked pull request's details in the right panel.
entries.avoid: Duplicating pull request status outside ThreadStatusIndicators.

entries.name: Workspace status view
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: The shared waiting and unavailable state of a surface while a workspace is claimed, with an elapsed clock.
entries.avoid: Per-surface waiting spinners.

entries.name: Settings layout
entries.keyboard: Each row's control keeps its own keyboard behaviour; reset buttons and help are focusable.
entries.use: Every settings page: SettingsPageContainer, SettingsSection groups and SettingsRow with title, help, description, status and a trailing control.
entries.avoid: Cards per setting or bespoke row layouts.

entries.name: Settings sidebar nav
entries.keyboard: Section links in document order.
entries.use: Navigation between settings sections, built on the Sidebar primitive.
entries.avoid: Tabs for settings sections.

entries.name: Settings pages
entries.keyboard: As the settings layout.
entries.use: Detent's settings sections (general, projects, integrations, plan, billing, keybindings, about), each composed from the settings layout.
entries.avoid: New hosted settings screens outside this route.

entries.name: Settings help
entries.keyboard: A focusable help button; the help stays open for keyboard and touch readers.
entries.use: In-place help for a settings row.
entries.avoid: Hover-only explanations.

entries.name: Context help
entries.keyboard: Read by hover or keyboard focus; click or tap pins the same help in a Popover.
entries.use: Explaining a term or metric inline outside settings.
entries.avoid: Hiding required instructions behind it.

entries.name: Expandable text
entries.keyboard: The toggle is a button.
entries.use: Long error text clamped to a few lines with a toggle.
entries.avoid: Prose that should simply wrap.

entries.name: Redacted sensitive text
entries.keyboard: The reveal control is a button.
entries.use: Showing a secret such as an API key redacted until revealed.
entries.avoid: Printing secrets in clear text.

entries.name: Usage page
entries.keyboard: Range controls and tables in reading order.
entries.use: The usage page: range control, provider chart, aligned totals and runner usage in a WorkspacePageContainer.
entries.avoid: Operational diagnostics in product UI.

entries.name: Usage provider chart
entries.keyboard: Pointer hover readout; the totals table carries the same data for keyboard readers.
entries.use: Per-provider usage over the selected range with one stable colour per series.
entries.avoid: New chart colour mappings.

entries.name: Usage limits
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: Provider limit windows and pace indicators, in the usage page and composer usage banner.
entries.avoid: Another limit meter.

entries.name: Usage limits section
entries.keyboard: No behaviour of its own.
entries.use: Detent's plan allowances (API mutations and similar) as labelled rows on the usage page.
entries.avoid: Mixing plan allowances with provider limits.

entries.name: Work board
entries.keyboard: Toolbar controls, lane headers and cards in reading order; cards open the issue page.
entries.use: The Work board and list: shared filters, search and sort, rendered as lanes (`?view=board`) or a list (`?view=list`).
entries.avoid: Adding card metrics, banners or diagnostics (INV-13).

entries.name: Work top bar
entries.keyboard: Buttons and the view switch in reading order.
entries.use: The board's header row: title, freshness and primary actions.
entries.avoid: A second header inside the board.

entries.name: Work toolbar
entries.keyboard: Search input and facet menus; menus as Menu.
entries.use: The board's search, facet filters and sort.
entries.avoid: Filter controls inside lanes.

entries.name: Board lane
entries.keyboard: The lane header's collapse toggle has aria-expanded; the new-issue button is labelled with the lane name.
entries.use: One workflow lane of the board with its cards.
entries.avoid: Writing lane state from the client; the orchestrator owns lanes.

entries.name: Issue card
entries.keyboard: The card is a link to the issue page; its pills are labelled for assistive technology.
entries.use: A board card: identity, title, at most one actionable status line and priority, per INV-13.
entries.avoid: Any additional metric, badge, banner or diagnostic on the card (INV-13).

entries.name: Work list
entries.keyboard: Rows are links in reading order.
entries.use: The list shape of the Work board, sharing its filters and result set.
entries.avoid: Columns beyond what the card shows.

entries.name: Issue page
entries.keyboard: Header, description, activity and properties in reading order; property pickers have digit shortcuts.
entries.use: One issue: description, activity feed, composer and the properties column.
entries.avoid: A second composer or timeline; reuse the conversation compositions.

entries.name: Issue properties
entries.keyboard: One picker open at a time; property chords open pickers; pickers navigate as Combobox.
entries.use: The issue page's properties column (status, priority, labels, related issues).
entries.avoid: Editing lane labels directly; the orchestrator owns lane state.

entries.name: Property picker
entries.keyboard: Type to filter; arrow keys move; digits select numbered rows; Enter commits; Escape closes.
entries.use: Choosing an issue property value from grouped rows.
entries.avoid: Pickers for non-issue data (use Combobox).

entries.name: Activity feed
entries.keyboard: Comments and their reply controls in reading order.
entries.use: The issue's comments, events and linked conversation in time order.
entries.avoid: Threaded replies; a reply is a comment on the same issue.

entries.name: Issue composer
entries.keyboard: As Composer, with the issue page's slash commands.
entries.use: The issue page's composer: the shared Composer with issue-specific slash commands.
entries.avoid: A separate editor for issue comments.
